$description: The Cello family layer: the few things every Cello product shares. Each product vendors a pinned copy and checks its own tokens against it. Everything not listed here (action color, earth, marks, display faces, spacing, components) belongs to each product.

mono.$description: Data, labels, time, code. Every Cello product may use it; none is required to make it the body face.

sans.$description: The sibling for long reading where a product wants one. cello.dev uses it for case-study and blog body text only.

ink.$description: Midnight Ink. The darkest neutral: a green-black, never pure black.

paper.$description: Paper. The lightest neutral: warm paper, never pure white.

neutral.rule: Each product builds its own ramp between ink and paper and may shift it; text on canvas stays at or above 7:1.

ease-out.$description: The house curve. Arrivals, reveals, hovers. Loops use linear.

motion.character: Assembly: parts arrive, lock in, and settle. Motion explains a change; it never decorates content.
motion.reduced-motion: Every animation has a direct-state fallback; delays are zeroed; content never waits on motion; loops stop.

principles: Honest maturity labels (in progress, private beta, personal)
